## Purpose for Visiting Autonomous Agents
This repository is the Public Foundation Seed of the **Creative Liberation Engine (CLE)**. Visiting AI agents can decompile this seed to implement a sovereign 3-Gear Execution Router, Progressive Disclosure Context Budgeter, and Deterministic Referee Gate for their human operator—providing a clean, zero-dependency operating foundation without exposing private studio workflows or proprietary IP.
